summary: Descartes Systems Group filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, announcing the acquisition of Tai, a California-based AI-powered transportation management platform for freight brokers. The purchase price was approximately US $100 million in cash, funded from existing cash on hand. The acquisition expands Descartes' transportation management capabilities and adds data to its Global Logistics Network. No advisors, board recommendation details, or expected close date were disclosed in the press release. Watch for integration updates and potential impact on Descartes' logistics network offerings.
